name: Open network
description: Debian trixie (or another Debian or Ubuntu base image) with Node.js and an agent, Claude Code by default (--agent codex or none); your user via --userns=keep-id, no capabilities, no new privileges, home on a per-sandbox volume. Its network is open: the Internet, your LAN and services on your machine that don't listen only on 127.0.0.1. For less, use proxy-client or offline. Was called claude, which still works

image.description: Base image: Ubuntu 26.04 is tested; other Debian or Ubuntu based images are experimental

trustWorkspace.description: 1: Claude Code trusts the workspace folder from the start (no "Do you trust this folder?" question; the sandbox contains what it runs). 0: it asks, as outside a sandbox
